evidence: Source contracts and official documentation reviewed; offline checks do not establish live acceptance.

api-auth.preferred: Framework/platform validation for incoming API tokens; MSAL only for client token acquisition.

browser-session.preferred: Easy Auth when host requirements match; supported MSAL flows otherwise. Retained session helpers are compatibility, not a full sign-in server.

access.preferred: Existing native orchestrator first; retained azaccess helpers for a justified host-owned imperative workflow.

managed-identity.preferred: Pinned AVM or native Bicep with one deployment owner and exact grant read-back.

container-apps.preferred: Tenant-pinned Easy Auth; keep application authorization. Do not allow anonymous traffic merely because a caller is headless.

sdk-experiment.preferred: Evidence only: official Azure RBAC SDK over synthetic transport, not a production provider.

features: single-tenant and legacy common issuer rules
capabilities.limit: No configuration or import grants caller authorization; legacy disabled mode is never deployed acceptance.

capabilities.outcome: Validate an incoming Entra API bearer token
capabilities.limit: Use maintained JWT cryptography; MSAL is not an incoming-access-token validator.

capabilities.outcome: Cache and refresh signing keys without per-request discovery
capabilities.limit: Legacy warm-cache staleness differs from strict bounded-stale policy; not interchangeable.

capabilities.outcome: Map verified claims into the legacy Principal API

capabilities.outcome: Return safe 401/403/404/503 error behavior
